title: Amazon API Gateway REST API to Amazon DynamoDB to Amazon Kinesis to AWS Lambda
description: Create an Amazon API Gateway REST API that integrates with Kinesis via a DynamoDB table

introBox.headline: How it works
text: This pattern will help you to deploy Amazon API Gateway API integration with Amazon DynamoDB. Additionally, the Amazon DynamoDB table has an Amazon Kinesis Data Stream to capture item-level changes in your table and replicates the changes to a Kinesis Data Stream.
Lastly, AWS Lambda will consume those changes from Amazon Kinesis to log the decoded message which was received from the Amazon Kinesis Stream.
